mechanics: Explicit castTarget/castPoint and live ability charge/cooldown queries are available; automatic bot spells remain enabled.
Poison now checks ordinary attack range and exposure; the old unrestricted poison probe does not apply.
Every class has a mana-free basic attack whose damage includes every equipped damage bonus; equipment is not class-locked.
Five different ordered equipment items can preserve one permanent slot for consumables. Six live slots, no sell, duplicate equipment rejected.
Competition map preset has fixed map seed 54 and resolution 116. Match seed independently changes simulation randomness.
API game-config artifact retains seed 2026 while completed results and replay carry the effective randomized seed; match comparisons must use the latter.
limitations: Source parity and three exact hosted replay reconstructions establish correspondence on those episodes; the local binary is not the hosted container.
Public replay inventory and actions describe incumbent behavior, not its private source or intentions.
